# CiteThis

> CiteThis is an online citation generator supporting multiple academic formats (MLA, APA, Chicago, Harvard, AMA, IEEE, Bluebook) for websites, books, articles, and multimedia sources.

CiteThis provides automated citation generation and formatting guides across seven major citation styles. The platform helps students and researchers quickly create properly formatted citations for academic work without manual formatting errors.

## Key Topics

- Citation Generator
- MLA Format
- APA Format
- Chicago Format
- Harvard Format
- IEEE Format
- AMA Format
- Bluebook Format
- Website Citation
- Book Citation
- Journal Article Citation
- Academic Writing
- Auto-Cite

- Citation Formats

## Citation Generators by Format

- [CiteThis Citation Generator](https://citethis.net): CiteThis homepage: generate citations in MLA, APA, Chicago, Harvard, AMA, IEEE styles
- [MLA Citation Generator](https://citethis.net/MLA): MLA citation generator for websites, books, articles, and videos
- [APA Citation Generator](https://citethis.net/APA): APA citation generator for websites, books, articles, multimedia, and newspapers
- [Chicago Citation Generator](https://citethis.net/Chicago): Chicago citation generator for websites, books, articles, and videos
- [Harvard Citation Generator](https://citethis.net/Harvard): Harvard citation generator for websites, books, articles, films, and videos
- [AMA Citation Generator](https://citethis.net/AMA): AMA citation generator for websites, books, articles, and videos
- [IEEE Citation Generator](https://citethis.net/IEEE): IEEE citation generator for websites, books, articles, and videos
- [Bluebook Citation Generator](https://citethis.net/Bluebook): Bluebook citation generator for legal citations and academic sources
